---
name: Playtest feedback
about: Tell me how it played. Short answers are fine, and nothing has to be broken.
title: "[Playtest] "
labels: feedback
---

**Version**
(e.g. rc Water; shown in the patch file name and README)

**How far did you get, and roughly how long did you play?**
(e.g. beat Mira, about 90 minutes)

**What was the most fun?**


**Where did you get stuck, bored or confused?**
(a fight, a place you could not find, a line you did not understand)

**Your team at that point**
(species and levels; stolen sigils if you remember them)

**Was any fight far too easy or far too hard?**
(which one, and on which difficulty)

**Would you keep playing? What would make you?**


**Emulator and device**
(e.g. mGBA 0.10 on Windows, Delta on iPhone)

**Anything else**
(a screenshot or a .sav file helps a lot)
